title: App crashes on login
description: App crashes when attempting to login with Google account.
resolution: Fixed the OAuth token expiration issue on login.

title: File upload fails
description: PDF files larger than 5MB fail to upload.
resolution: Increased file size limit in the server settings to 10MB.

title: Password reset not working
description: Users are not receiving password reset emails.
resolution: Fixed SMTP server configuration and re-enabled the email service.

title: Mobile app freezes
description: App freezes after updating to the latest version on Android.
resolution: Released a patch that resolves the compatibility issue with Android 12.

title: Slow performance on dashboard
description: Dashboard takes too long to load when there are multiple filters applied.
resolution: Optimized database queries and reduced loading time by 40%.

title: Unable to make payments
description: Payment gateway throws error during transaction.
resolution: Reconfigured the payment gateway integration to handle international cards.

title: Search results inaccurate
description: The search bar shows irrelevant results for common queries.
resolution: Fixed the search algorithm to prioritize exact match keywords.

title: Notification not received
description: Push notifications are not delivered to iOS devices.
resolution: Resolved the issue with the iOS notification service certificate renewal.

title: Can't access account
description: Users are unable to access their accounts after recent update.
resolution: Addressed a bug in user authentication logic that occurred after the update.

title: Missing user data
description: Some user data is missing after the migration process.
resolution: Investigated the migration process and restored missing records from backup.
